description: This Python module provides utilities for configuring LiveKit rooms and tokens, including functions to generate access tokens for participants and agents, and asynchronous configuration functions that parse command-line arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: generate_token
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a participant in a LiveKit room with specified identity and grants.

methods.name: generate_token_with_agent
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an agent participant with agent-specific grants.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Asynchronously configures and returns the LiveKit server URL, token, and room name based on environment variables or command-line arguments.

methods.name: configure_with_args
methods.description: Asynchronously parses command-line arguments and environment variables to configure LiveKit connection parameters.
